# Fun Workshop 2026 Summer & ClawTwin Initiative

> Repository manifest optimized for LLMs and AI agents.

This repository contains the source code and content for the Fun Workshop 2026 Summer website. The website is structured as a single-page app that dynamically renders markdown files. All core information is located in the Markdown source files under the `components/` directory.

## Core Information Index

- [Letter (English)](components/letter_en.md) - Coordinator's introductory letter, initiative background, and overview of projects.
- [Letter (Chinese)](components/letter_zh.md) - Coordinator's introductory letter, initiative background, and overview of projects (Chinese).
- [Program (English)](components/program_en.md) - Program tracks (ClawTwin & OpenClaw Workshop), weekly coffee party logistics, warning notes, and co-organizers.
- [Program (Chinese)](components/program_zh.md) - Program tracks (ClawTwin & OpenClaw Workshop), weekly coffee party logistics, warning notes, and co-organizers (Chinese).
- [Syllabus (English)](components/syllabus_en.md) - Weekly course schedules, topics (basic to advanced), prerequisites, and fees.
- [Syllabus (Chinese)](components/syllabus_zh.md) - Weekly course schedules, topics (basic to advanced), prerequisites, and fees (Chinese).
- [Detailed Syllabus](syllabus-detailed.md) - Exhaustive per-session plan with course rhythm, topics, hands-on tasks, and acceptance criteria.
- [FAQ (English)](components/faq_en.md) - Frequently Asked Questions regarding personal agents vs commercial LLMs, privacy/security, and requirements.
- [FAQ (Chinese)](components/faq_zh.md) - Frequently Asked Questions regarding personal agents vs commercial LLMs, privacy/security, and requirements (Chinese).
- [Join Us (English)](components/join_en.md) - Volunteer application form, roles, and instructions.
- [Join Us (Chinese)](components/join_zh.md) - Volunteer application form, roles, and instructions (Chinese).

## Key Metadata
- **Venue**: Cozy Coffee, 1st Floor, E Building, XJTLU Taicang Campus, Suzhou, China.
- **Timeline**: June - August, 2026.
- **First Session**: June 18, 2026.
- **Prerequisites**: Laptop (Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges) and a budget of 50-200 RMB for model APIs.
- **Fees**: Initiative is free (with Cozy Coffee purchase); Workshop is 50 RMB per session (40 RMB if attending the Initiative).
- **Coordinator**: Shiyao Zhang (shiyao.zhang14@student.xjtlu.edu.cn).
